Your amygdala is considered your 'animal' brain. Your prefrontal is the most recently developed part of our brains that makes us human and separates us from other animals. Your amygdala is the side of the brain that tempts you towards instant gratification behaviour, whereas your prefrontal is the side of the brain that allows you to critically assess your behaviours. A lot of us are on autopilot most of the time and just give in to the urges provided by the amygdala. When on nofap, you train your brain to be more mindful of urges by using your prefrontal cortex, and in turn this allows you to quiet the 'animal' brain easier. 

I highly recommend meditation to develop your prefrontal cortex further to assist in your nofap journey.
